mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the horizon indicates monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline is not sustained or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of UNRATE above 4.5 percentage points signals weakening labor market strength, prompting risk aversion and negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses threshold without negative returns or returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO over the horizon reflects robust business activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO increase is not sustained or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (personal consumption) and HOUST (housing starts) signal robust demand growth, amplifying equity valuation growth and driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both proxies rise >0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: Proxies do not both rise sufficiently or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 over the horizon reflects strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 increase is not sustained or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS during a late-cycle expansion signals accommodative policy, enhancing equity risk premium expectations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline is not sustained or returns over 60 days are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in UNRATE (improving labor market) and rise in PAYEMS (job growth) signals labor market strengthening, reducing risk premium and driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls >0.2pp AND PAYEMS rises >0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: Proxies do not move in expected directions or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of INDPRO above 105 triggers expectations of robust industrial activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises >5 points above 105 in the prior month
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses threshold without positive returns or returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
